verdict.rationale: BILL's platform covers AP alongside Spend & Expense. It documents bill approval policies with custom rules, AI multi-line bill coding, bill creation through to AP payment, and vendor payments by ACH, virtual card, or BILL-printed and mailed check, plus international payments. Missing for 10: explicit wire transfer as a disbursement method, explicit invoice capture/OCR or email-in ingestion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
